observations.expected: One round face-on radiopaque disc projects at the thoracic inlet.
observations.observed: A single circular, uniformly opaque disc (coin orientation en face) is visible in the midline at the level of the thoracic inlet/upper mediastinum, consistent with an oesophageal coin.

observations.expected: Visible neck and chest anatomy is coherent for a child.
observations.observed: The cervical and thoracic spine are continuous and coherent. Bilateral clavicles and scapulae are present, one per side. Rib pairs are symmetric and appropriately counted bilaterally. The heart shadow is single and midline-left. Hemidiaphragms are visible bilaterally. Lung markings branch and taper normally. Open physes are visible at the humeral heads and clavicles. Mixed dentition is visible in the partially included mandible, appropriate for a child aged 3–11. No duplicated, floating, or garbled structures are identified.
